debugQ1Options.text: Module 6: the retry has no backoff at all, it retries instantly in a tight loop and never uses jitter, exactly the retry-storm risk
Module 4: the retry function doesn't check an idempotency key before calling the model
debugQ1Options.reason: Retrying this outbound model call isn't a duplicate-tool-execution problem, the idempotency concern from Module 4 is about tool calls with real side effects, a plain model call being retried doesn't have that risk here.

debugQ1Options.text: Module 5: the retry has no step limit at all
debugQ1Options.reason: It does have a bound, attempt >= 5 raises and stops recursing. The problem isn't the absence of a limit, it's that every attempt up to that limit fires instantly with no delay.
